_comment: R32 for A2: one single-edit mutant per invariant tests/a claims, each with the case names that must catch it on an assertion. Run with `node tests/a/run-mutants.mjs`. The real-PG cases (grant-pg.test.ts) need a database and are not in this list; the DB rules they exercise are A1's own mutants (tests/d/signup_mutants.py).

mutants.note: the grant is claimed for an id taken from the URL instead of the verified session

cases: A2-CB-03 a verified callback claims the grant ONCE, for the server-verified user, never an id from the URL
A2-CB-04 the token-hash form verifies the OTP with its type, then claims
